discussions.title: Welcome to Climate Errata
discussions.author: klemmeri
discussions.body: ## Welcome to Climate Errata Climate Errata is an independent register of errors and issues found in climate papers, datasets and code. Every entry is reproducible: it comes with the code and data needed to check it. **How it works** - Each finding is reported privately to the authors or developers first. Nothing is posted here until they have replied or three weeks have passed. - Each entry shows its status (reported, acknowledged, disputed, fixed or released) and records the responsible party's reply. - Each entry has its own discussion thread. Comments on methods, data and reproduction are welcome, and authors are invited to respond. **Ground rules** - Discuss methods and data, not people or motives. - Back claims with evidence or code wherever possible. - If we get something wrong, we correct it openly. Maintained by Mark L. Morrissey, Ph.D. (Professor Emeritus of Meteorology).
